Questions

Frequently asked questions

What does GenFloe do?

GenFloe helps small businesses build credibility and strengthen their professional presence. We currently specialize in professionally designed and managed websites, with plans to expand into additional business growth solutions.

What types of businesses do you work with?

We focus on small businesses, including local service providers and retail businesses. Our goal is to provide practical solutions that fit each business's needs and stage of growth.

What services are currently available?

Our current offering is professional website design and ongoing management, starting at $49 per month with no upfront website design fee. Additional services are part of our long-term vision and are not yet available.

How do I get started with GenFloe?

Contact us and tell us a little about your business. We'll discuss your goals, explain our current solutions, and help you determine whether they're a good fit.
